details:
VRC has introduced a variety of fun features.

Stickers, printed photos, items – these make communication more enjoyable.

However, these objects often become distractions within the game world.

Stickers placed in the game's play area are distracting and may cause players to misinterpret something.

And, printed photos and items are obstructive if they're floating in the game's play area.

Their interactability is also disruptive, and depending on the object, they can potentially obstruct the player's field of view.

Let's take Murder4 as an example.

Suppose you need to find a revolver lying on the ground. What if that revolver is hidden beneath the “Bonfire” item? You'd likely struggle to find it.

Or what if a bubble machine is left near a knife? In a situation where you need to grab the knife quickly, you might accidentally pick up the bubble machine instead.

It might sound like a joke, but when playing competitively, you realise these items are surprisingly distracting elements.

Stickers can be hidden in bulk, but items cannot be hidden collectively; they must be hidden individually.

Even if you hide an item, you must hide it again if it is retrieved.

Furthermore, whilst stickers can be hidden in bulk, doing so requires navigating through multiple layers of settings. Moreover, this setting must be applied each time you enter an instance or launch VRC. This is extremely inconvenient.

What I'm asking for isn't that items be disabled, but that players who wish to hide them be given the option to do so in bulk.
title: Add an option to hide items in bulk
